title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：outside　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 outside 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the father ① saw the outside that no neighbour in the house would have measured, and he said the seeing was the whole of the month. The ② outside, meaning the surface itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; outside, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of outside in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ outside at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Outside, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the father said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the outside was the whole of the matter, meaning the freedom and not the surface. The ⑥ outside, meaning the freedom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; outside, he said, is either something you see or the only word that means both surface and a freedom. He said the freedom is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ outside had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ outside of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of measuring; outside, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ outside I remember is the outside measured in the letter, which closed in 1996 and is still measured as the quietest in the house. ⑩ Outside, my mother said in 1998, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all outside, she said, is a freedom that has agreed to look like surface. She said the freedom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 外部；外面（指老屋里每一样旁边的那一样）
B. n. 外部；外面（指那面外部本身，与小小的板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：see the outside 看见这一面外部
D. n. 外部；外面（指留给孩子们搬的那一只）
E. n. 外部之事（抽象总称，指一处老屋的外部之事）
F. n. 外部；外面（指家书里写到、被测量的那一面）
G. n. 外部、自在（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 自在（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: saw the outside that no neighbour in the house would have measured
The outside, meaning the surface itself and not the chair
Every sort of outside in that house
the outside at the far door

answers.why: see the outside 意为“看见这一面外部”，1989 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯测量的一面外部做了一遍。
outside 意为“外部；外面”，指那面外部本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
outside 意为“外部；外面”，指老屋里每一样旁边的那一样，每一样旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
outside 意为“外部；外面”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
outside 意为“外部、自在”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这面自在就是那件事的全部。
outside 意为“自在”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那面外部，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
outside 意为“外部；外面”，指家书里写到、被测量的那一面，到 1994 年这一面成了家书里的一行。
outside 意为“外部之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的外部之事是一处老屋和三个月份的测量。
outside 意为“外部；外面”，我记得的是家书里测量过的那一面，1996 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一面。
outside 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，外部是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的外部。
